SELECT 'EDHR_WORK_TASK' AS source_id, CONCAT('H',LPAD(CAST(h.id AS CHAR),20,'0')) AS row_order_key, CONCAT('handoff:',h.id) AS business_id, CONCAT('EDHR_WORK_TASK:handoff:',h.id) AS task_key, '批记录' AS task_type, 'eDHR工作任务' AS source, CONVERT(CONCAT(CASE h.task_type WHEN 'PRODUCTION_HANDOFF' THEN '请填写本人负责的生产工序并签名提交' WHEN 'PRODUCTION_REVIEW' THEN '请核对生产原始记录并签名复核' WHEN 'PRODUCTION_RETURN' THEN '请按退回原因更正生产记录并重新签名' WHEN 'PQC_HANDOFF' THEN '请填写本人负责的PQC检验并签名提交' WHEN 'PQC_REVIEW' THEN '请核对首检或巡检原始结果并签名复核' WHEN 'PQC_RETURN' THEN '请按退回原因更正检验记录并重新签名' WHEN 'QA_REVIEW' THEN '请完成 QA 不合格评审' WHEN 'QA_DECISION_HANDOFF' THEN '请接手 QA 处置结果' ELSE '交接任务类型未识别，请核实任务数据' END, CHAR(10), '工序：', CASE WHEN h.task_type IN ('PQC_REVIEW','PQC_RETURN') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(qp.process_name, ''), '检验工序名称缺失，请核对记录') ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.responsibility_snapshot_json, '$.processName')), ''), '工序名称缺失，请核对记录') END, CASE WHEN h.task_type IN ('PQC_REVIEW','PQC_RETURN') THEN CONCAT('｜', CASE pt.inspection_type WHEN 'FIRST' THEN '首检' WHEN 'PATROL' THEN '巡检' WHEN 'FINAL' THEN '末检' ELSE '检验类型缺失，请核对记录' END, '·第', COALESCE(CAST(pt.round_no AS CHAR), '轮次缺失'), '轮') ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN h.task_type IN ('PRODUCTION_REVIEW','PQC_REVIEW') THEN '｜提交人：' WHEN h.task_type IN ('PRODUCTION_RETURN','PQC_RETURN') THEN '｜退回人：' ELSE '｜发起人：' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.responsibility_snapshot_json, '$.initiator.name')), ''), '人员姓名缺失，请核对记录'), '｜办理要求：', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(h.reason), '') IS NULL THEN '办理要求缺失，请核对记录' ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(h.reason), CHAR(10), 1) END) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS detail, CASE WHEN h.due_time IS NOT NULL AND h.due_time <= NOW() THEN '已超期·待处理' WHEN h.task_type IN ('PRODUCTION_REVIEW','PQC_REVIEW') THEN '待复核' ELSE '待接手' END AS status_label, h.create_time AS created_at, h.due_time AS due_at, CONVERT(h.task_type USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS domain_task_type, CONVERT(h.action_url USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS action_url, NULL AS batch_execution_id, NULL AS batch_task_id, NULL AS execution_id, 'ACTIVE_ORDER_HANDOFF' AS business_scope_type, CAST(h.active_order_id AS CHAR) AS business_scope_id, NULL AS signature_cell_key FROM mes_active_order_handoff_task h LEFT JOIN mes_pqc_inspection_task pt ON h.task_type IN ('PQC_REVIEW','PQC_RETURN') AND pt.id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.responsibility_snapshot_json, '$.pqcTaskId')) AND pt.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND pt.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN mes_qa_inspection_regulation_process qp ON qp.id=pt.qa_process_id AND qp.regulation_version_id=pt.regulation_version_id AND qp.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND qp.deleted=0
WHERE h.tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND h.deleted=0 AND h.task_type IN ('PRODUCTION_HANDOFF','PRODUCTION_RETURN','PQC_HANDOFF','PQC_RETURN','QA_DECISION_HANDOFF','QA_REVIEW') AND h.status='TODO' AND h.notification_only=0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{q.userId},h.candidate_user_snapshot)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_pro_process_pool_active_order ao WHERE ao.id=h.active_order_id AND ao.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND ao.deleted=0 AND ao.active_status='ACTIVE')
